paper_title: Microwave cavity light shining through a wall optimization and experiment
notes: First microwave-cavity LSW hidden-sector-photon search (UWA, Povey-Hartnett-Tobar). Curve digitised from the pink 'This experiment' wedge in Fig. 11 (a raster figure, redondo_editted.eps, hand-edited in Photoshop over the Goodsell et al. bound plot); axes calibrated per-tick (x=Log10 m[eV], y=Log10 chi). The wedge is a V: left diagonal from (2.5e-6 eV, chi~1) down to a tip at (2.4e-5 eV, 3.8e-5), then a vertical cutoff edge at m~2.8e-5 eV back up to chi~1. Note: the hand-drawn figure region is displaced ~0.15-0.2 dex from the values quoted in the text (peak chi=2.9e-5 at m=3.788e-5 eV = hbar*omega*sqrt(1-0.3^2) for f=9.588 GHz, TE011 mode); an independent physical reconstruction of the limit via Eq.(1) with the geometric function G computed numerically (validated against the paper's peak F^2=9825 Ohm^2 at k'/k=0.3 and Fig. 6) reproduces the quoted peak exactly but sits ~0.2 dex to the right of the figure's wedge. The figure as printed was digitised (as a compilation maintainer would); no CL stated in the paper (limit = leakage-signal strength, SNR=1), 0.95 entered as placeholder. Lab LSW experiment: no dark-matter density assumption.
